corpus.text: Reset your password: open Settings, choose Account, then Reset password. We send a link to your email. The link works for 30 minutes.
Turn on two-step sign-in to protect your account. Use an authenticator app or a hardware security key.
No sign-in email? Look in your spam folder, then ask for a new link. Each new link cancels the old one.
Change the email address on your account in Settings, Account. Confirm the new address before it takes effect.
Delete your account in Settings, Account, Delete account. Your synced notes are erased from the server after 14 days.
Error 409 is a sync conflict: two devices changed the same note at the same time. The app keeps both versions and marks one copy Conflicted.
After a password change, every other device signs out. Sign in again on each device to resume sync.
Sync pauses while Low Power Mode is on. It resumes when you plug in or turn Low Power Mode off.
Notes sync with end-to-end encryption. The server stores only ciphertext and cannot read them.
To force a sync, pull down on the note list, or press Command-R on a Mac.
Error 503 during sync means the service is busy. The app retries on its own and waits longer after each try.
Cancel your subscription in the App Store: open Settings, tap your name, then Subscriptions. Pro stays active until the end of the period.
Annual plans get a full refund during the first 14 days. Write to support with your order number.
Pro adds unlimited devices, one year of version history and 100 GB of attachments.
Students get 50% off the annual plan after they verify a school email address.
Export notes as Markdown, PDF or plain text from File, Export. Attachments go into a folder next to the export.
Import a folder of Markdown files with File, Import. Front matter becomes note properties.
Print a note with Command-P. Choose Include attachments to print images inline.
Back up your library with File, Back up library. It makes one archive with every note, tag and attachment.
To make the battery last longer, lower the screen brightness, quit apps that run in the background and turn off live previews.
Launch is slow when the library holds many large PDF attachments. Move old attachments to an archive notebook.
The app reads the text in photos and scans on your device and adds it to search.
Every note is stored on your device, so the app works offline. Edits sync when you are back online.
Dark mode follows the system setting. To choose it yourself, open Settings, Appearance.
Tags: type # and a name anywhere in a note. Nested tags use a slash, like #work/hiring.
Pin a note to keep it at the top of the list. You can pin up to 20 notes.
Save any note as a template, then pick it from New note, From template.
Link notes: type [[ and the title of another note. Backlinks show at the bottom of the linked note.
Recover a deleted note from Recently deleted. Notes stay there for 30 days.
Version history keeps earlier copies of a note: one year on Pro, 7 days on the free plan.
Share a note with a link. Anyone with the link can read it. Turn on Allow edits to let them change it.
Shared notebooks let a team edit together. Each person needs their own account.
Error E-4012: the shared link has expired. Ask the owner for a new link.
The app shows no ads and never sells your data.
Lock a note with Face ID or Touch ID: open the note, then choose Lock.
Analytics are off by default. You can turn on anonymous crash reports in Settings, Privacy.
If the app freezes at launch, hold Option while you open it to start in safe mode without plugins.
Error E-2207 means the local database file is damaged. The app rebuilds it from the last backup.
Images do not load? Check free disk space. The app needs at least 1 GB free to download attachments.
Keyboard shortcuts: Command-N new note, Command-F find in note, Command-Shift-F search all notes.

graph.cypher:
CALL ze.hybrid_search($q, 3, 'exact') YIELD node, score
MATCH (m:Meeting)-[:HAS_NOTES]->(node), (p:Person)-[:ATTENDED]->(m)
RETURN m.title AS meeting, score, collect(p.name) AS people
ORDER BY score DESC
